label: git-tree-digest-history-proof
command:
import json,pathlib,re,hashlib,subprocess
ep=pathlib.Path(".agent/tasks/production-readiness-20260917/evidence")
base=pathlib.Path("/private/tmp/localos-git-history-verified-20260921.qZcoBF")
manifest=json.loads((ep/"git-all-refs-manifest-20260921.json").read_text())
ctx=json.loads(json.loads((ep/"git-tree-digest-context-20260921.json").read_text())["stdout"])
report=json.loads((base/"tree-blobs-redacted.json").read_text())
paths=sorted({p["path"].removeprefix("/app/") for r in ctx["rows"] for p in r["digest_fields"] if p["key_is_code_path"]})
env={"PATH":"/usr/bin:/bin","GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS":"1","GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM":"1","GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL":"/dev/null","GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT":"0"}
def git(args,inp=None):
 c=subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/git",*args],input=inp,env=env,capture_output=True,timeout=35,check=False)
 if c.returncode!=0: raise SystemExit("Scoped Git metadata read failed; output withheld")
 return c.stdout
obj=git(["rev-list","--objects",*manifest["commitTips"],"--",*paths])
oids={}
for line in obj.decode().splitlines():
 pieces=line.split(" ",1)
 if len(pieces)==2 and pieces[1] in paths: oids[pieces[0]]=pieces[1]
assert len(oids)<3000
raw=git(["cat-file","--batch"],("\n".join(oids)+"\n").encode())
at=0; digest={}
for oid in oids:
 end=raw.index(b"\n",at); header=raw[at:end].decode().split(); assert header[0]==oid and header[1]=="blob"
 size=int(header[2]); body=raw[end+1:end+1+size]; assert len(body)==size
 digest[hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()]={"blob":oid,"path":oids[oid]}
 at=end+1+size; assert raw[at:at+1]==b"\n"; at+=1
assert at==len(raw)
rows=[]
for i in [13,*range(16,40)]:
 f=report[i-1]; source=(base/"tree-only-blobs"/pathlib.Path(f["File"]).name).read_text().splitlines()[f["StartLine"]-1]
 parts=f["Match"].split("REDACTED")
 vals=set(m.group(1) for m in re.finditer(re.escape(parts[0])+r"(.+?)"+re.escape(parts[1]),source)); assert len(vals)==1
 v=next(iter(vals)); hit=digest.get(v)
 rows.append({"finding_id":i,"matches_frozen_path_history":hit is not None,"matching_source":hit})
print(json.dumps({"scoped_paths":paths,"source_blobs_hashed":len(oids),"source_bytes_in_memory":len(raw),"rows":rows,"matches":sum(r["matches_frozen_path_history"] for r in rows),"values_withheld":True},indent=2))
